name: Clipper Day Camp
description_short: Town day camp in Yarmouth for kids entering kindergarten to grade 5. Grades K and 1 meet at Rowe School and grades 2 to 5 at Yarmouth Elementary School, with gym and outdoor games, crafts, pool days and weekly field trips.
